memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land.” - Isaiah 1:19

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Jesus often asked people a deep question: “Do you WANT to be made whole?” The man who lay for 38 years explained his difficulties, but Jesus was not asking about his problem  He was asking about his will.
The blind man said, “Lord, I WANT to see,” and Jesus gave him sight. Their miracles began the moment their will agreed with God.

Spiritually, victories begin not in circumstances but in the decision of the will. God doesn’t force anyone to pray, forgive, stay holy, or grow. But when your heart says a strong YES, grace flows and strength rises. Your will is the place where God and man meet. If you will, you win.

If you WILL to pray - you WIN over dryness.
If you WILL to forgive - you WIN over bitterness.
If you WILL to stay holy - you WIN over temptation.
If you WILL to stand for Jesus - you WIN over fear.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God gives every bird its food, but He does not throw it into the nest.” — J.G. Holland

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, strengthen my will to choose You daily. Let my decisions honour You. Give me the desire to pray, forgive, stay holy, and stand boldly for You. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May God fill your heart with a victorious will.
May every “yes” you say to Him open a new blessing.
